pre_command: osascript -e 'tell application "Preview" to quit' && sleep 2 && rm -f ~/Documents/PreviewTasks/enhanced_product_shot.png && mkdir -p ~/Documents/PreviewTasks/ && [ -f ~/Documents/PreviewTasks/product_shot.png ] || curl -s -o ~/Documents/PreviewTasks/product_shot.png "https://images.rawpixel.com/image_800/cHJpdmF0ZS9sci9pbWFnZXMvd2Vic2l0ZS8yMDI1LTAxL3Jhd3BpeGVsb2ZmaWNlNV9hX2NpbmVtYXRpY19zaG90X29mX3NwcmluZ19mbG93ZXJfZmllbGRfbGFuZHNjYV85OWUyNjU5YS1hZDIwLTRhZjItYWFjYS1mMWY2YWVjYjJhMmRfMS5qcGc.jpg"
instruction: Open the `product_shot.png` file located in `~/Documents/PreviewTasks/`, use the 'Adjust Color' feature to increase the exposure slightly, and save the modified image as `enhanced_product_shot.png` in the same directory.
evaluator: if [ -f ~/Documents/PreviewTasks/enhanced_product_shot.png ] && [ -s ~/Documents/PreviewTasks/enhanced_product_shot.png ]; then orig_size=$(stat -f %z ~/Documents/PreviewTasks/product_shot.png 2>/dev/null); enhanced_size=$(stat -f %z ~/Documents/PreviewTasks/enhanced_product_shot.png 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$orig_size" ] && [ -n "$enhanced_size" ] && [ "$orig_size" -ne "$enhanced_size" ]; then echo True; else echo False; fi; else echo False; fi
